title: Pinch
body:
You are handsome. Your mustache suits you. You look like a good kid.
Are you heading to the intercity bus station?
Where are you off to? Kavala? Larissa?

-I'm going to pick up a parcel.

Take care of yourself, my boy, may God bless you.
Do you know where I'm going?
-Where?

I'm going to shoot up.
and his eyes welled with tears, his voice trembled, his face contorted.

I'm in so much pain, my boy. I have no mother, no father, they died in my arms.
I got mixed up in things. How did I end up like this?
I have no family, my wife divorced me, my children don't want me.
What am I doing? I'm in so much pain, my boy. If I start telling you my life story, you'll cry.
and the more space I gave him, the more he talked.

I'm looking to get high, that's where I ended up.
I have no one to tell these things to. I'm hurting, my boy. Take care of yourself, my boy, may God bless you.
and he got off at the next stop.

Along with him, I hurt too. He asked me for nothing, no money, not to sell me anything, nor to harass me.
Just a little time and an embrace for his pain. Even though he had all the stereotypical external features of the hardened criminal immigrant.

In that hardened criminal immigrant, I saw a little child
screaming for love and understanding.

What do you see, where you are looking?

y.f.
